Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. Procurement asked me to send over our initial SOW and a couple of questions before we route for PO. Attached is the private-plan SOW (private-plan-sow-greenwave-v1.pdf).

Key items procurement flagged:
- DPA: we need a version that includes a 60-day data deletion requirement after contract termination (including backups).

- SLA & credits: need clarity on how availability is measured for multi-region fallbacks and whether credits are pro-rated monthly or per-incident.

Thanks,

Olivia / team — attaching a short legal summary and DPA redlines for GreenWave (DPA_redlines_GW.docx). Main points:
1) Data deletion: we can accept a 60-day deletion requirement with a clear definition of "backups" and an obligation to certify deletion within 75 days of termination.
2) Liability caps: propose cap equal to 12 months of fees (we can discuss exceptions for gross negligence).
3) SOC 2: we can provide the latest SOC 2 Type II report under NDA; suggest an evidence-sharing provision for the marketplace listing.
4) SLA measurement: recommend defining availability on the effective region for the private plan and an explicit fallback measurement.

I'll consolidate markups into a redline amendment and send a DocuSign link for the amendment once commercial terms are agreed.

Kimberly Park
